title: Artificial Intelligence-Generated Content Moderation
summary: Hangzhou Dianzi University reports roughly 95% deepfake-detection accuracy and applications with public-security authorities.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The submission describes forgery detection and generated-content review. It reports a roughly 95% challenge result and police applications, alongside further platform development. Prevented fraud losses and societal safety effects remain unmeasured.
purpose: Identify manipulated media and support generated-content review.

ratings.reason: The system reportedly achieves approximately 95% deepfake-detection accuracy in a challenge and is applied in police work.
The detection results do not establish the amount of loss or other harm avoided by users.
Safer information ecosystems are anticipated rather than measured.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 6: Artificial Intelligence-Generated Content Moderation

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: A deepfake model reports 95% accuracy and police applications
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
